text: Verified manufacturer-authored flag semantics in SR Research EyeLink II User Manual v2.14 section4.9.2.1 printedp81/PDFp88 (https://www.bjbrainvision.com/uploads/20201202/c28e58251454de21de1c86b8a6fb0a8d.pdf). CR-mode monocular samples end in a three-character warning token; binocular samples in a five-character token. First position I denotes tracker interpolation; monocular positions2 C/3 R denote CR missing/recovery; binocular position2/3 left and4/5 right. Dot denotes no warning. Raw token and these source-observed flags must be retained separately from inferred missing gaze; do not relabel tracker-interpolated samples as raw observations. Independent counts recorded /private/tmp/eyes4s-real-asc-zenodo1156863/cr-flags-accounting.json. Required compatibility work confirmed; full original ASC unchanged.
